sources.snippet: An experimental MLX backend is available for Apple Silicon. It runs the OmniVoice diffusion language model with MLX and keeps the Higgs audio tokenizer on Transformers/PyTorch.

sources.title: mlx-community/OmniVoice-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it delivers high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design.
